fact: 1943年是二战转折年：2月2日斯大林格勒德军投降，东线战略主动权转入苏军；7月5日—8月23日库尔斯克坦克会战，标志德军在东线进攻能力终结；9月意大利停战；11—12月德黑兰会议确定1944年诺曼底登陆。

sources.title: Battle of Stalingrad – Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.quote: Battle of Stalingrad, (July 17, 1942–February 2, 1943)... It stopped the German advance into the Soviet Union and marked the turning of the tide of war in favour of the Allies.

sources.title: Battle of Kursk – Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.quote: Battle of Kursk, (July 5–August 23, 1943)... It marked the decisive end of the German offensive capability on the Eastern Front and cleared the way for the great Soviet offensives of 1944–45.

fact: 1942年12月英国政府发布贝弗里奇报告（《社会保险及相关服务》），1943年在英国国内引发关于战后福利国家蓝图的全国大辩论；该报告成为战后英国福利国家的蓝图。

sources.title: Beveridge Report – Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.quote: The Beveridge Report, officially titled Social Insurance and Allied Services (1942), was a landmark work by William Henry Beveridge. This report was instrumental in shaping Britain's post-World War II welfare state.

fact: 1943年全球配给与饥荒并存：英国配给进入第三年；苏联城市工人凭配给卡获得面包等基本食品；孟加拉大饥荒造成约150万—300万人超额死亡（Amartya Sen估计约300万，Dyson/Maharatna重新估计约180万—210万）。

sources.title: Demographic Responses to Famines in South Asia – Institute of Development Studies
sources.quote: Sen's conclusion that the 1943-44 Bengal famine caused roughly 3 million excess deaths has been widely cited. But because of the newly unearthed data for undivided Bengal, it too needs amending... it produces an estimate of 1.8 to 1.9 million excess deaths. A slightly more sophisticated approach... produces an estimate of 2.1 million.

sources.quote: Хлеб, мука, крупы, сахар, масло, мясо, рыба - все по карточкам.

fact: 1943年战时法律继续扩展：苏联配给卡与工作单位绑定，未经许可离职即失去配给；英国《官方保密法》约束布莱切利园工作人员终身缄默；意大利9月停战后法律状态分裂为南部盟军占领区与北部德国占领区。

sources.title: How Occupied France Financed Its Own Exploitation – NBER
sources.quote: The Germans requisitioned food, raw materials and finished goods on a large scale, and imposed occupation costs on the occupied territories.

fact: 1943年全球战时金融体系继续运转：苏联战时公债与国防基金合计覆盖约15%战争开支；英国依赖美国租借法案；全球黄金黑市价格高于美国官方35美元/盎司。

fact: 1943年战争技术继续突破：布莱切利园Colossus电子计算机在1944年1月交付（1943年研发）；下塔吉尔与车里雅宾斯克东迁工厂成为T-34坦克主要生产基地；跨伊朗铁路扩能保障波斯走廊租借物资运苏。

sources.title: Colossus – Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.quote: Colossus, the first large-scale electronic computer, which went into operation in 1944 at Britain's wartime code-breaking headquarters at Bletchley Park... The first Colossus was delivered to Bletchley Park in January 1944.
